# Terminal Workbench

Terminal Workbench is a terminal-inspired interface with calm graphite backgrounds, crisp typography and restrained ANSI-style accents over a dense, high-contrast working surface. It adds monospace micro-labels, framed code blocks with language headers, custom task-state colours and styled Mermaid diagrams, while respecting Obsidian's own fonts and accent.

![Terminal Workbench screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/real-fruit-snacks/terminal-workbench/HEAD/screenshot.png)
